ArtifactInput.description: A stored Hawser artifact (e.g. the output of a previous run).
ArtifactInput.title: ArtifactInput

ArtifactRef.description: A lightweight pointer carried in results, events and RPC messages.
ArtifactRef.title: ArtifactRef

AssetManifest.description: Everything admission learned about an input before any model saw it.
AssetManifest.title: AssetManifest

BBox.description: Axis-aligned box; ``x0,y0`` is the top-left corner, ``x1,y1`` the bottom-right.
BBox.title: BBox

CalculationEvidence.description: A deterministic computation: the expression and the evidence ids of its inputs.
CalculationEvidence.title: CalculationEvidence

CoordinateSystem.description: Where a box/point lives. Evidence always records this so it can be mapped back.
CoordinateSystem.title: CoordinateSystem

DpiTransform.description: PDF points → pixels at a given DPI (72 points per inch).
DpiTransform.title: DpiTransform

FieldMeta.description: Per-field sidecar: evidence, issues and extraction status (ADR-0005).
FieldMeta.title: FieldMeta

InlineInput.description: Small text or JSON given inline.
InlineInput.title: InlineInput

Limits.description: Hard caps. ``None`` means "use the deployment default".
Limits.title: Limits

LimitsApplied.description: The admission limits in force when the asset was admitted (for reproducibility).
LimitsApplied.title: LimitsApplied

LineageEvidence.description: Points at a parent artifact and the transformation that produced the current one.
LineageEvidence.title: LineageEvidence

PathInput.description: A local file path. Resolved and uploaded by the SDK before submission.
PathInput.title: PathInput

Pricing.description: USD per million tokens unless stated otherwise.
Pricing.title: Pricing

ProducerRef.description: What produced an artifact, evidence item or result: a tool, a model or the runtime.
ProducerRef.title: ProducerRef

RepairKind.description: What the runtime may try for a repairable issue (blueprint §16).
RepairKind.title: RepairKind

Revision.description: A result snapshot. Machine revisions are immutable; reviews create new ones.
Revision.title: Revision

RunRequest.description: What a caller submits. Either ``instruction`` or ``skill`` (or both) must be present.
RunRequest.title: RunRequest

RunStatus.description: Run lifecycle. See :mod:`hawser.runtime.state` for the allowed transitions.
RunStatus.title: RunStatus

StorageInput.description:
An authenticated object-storage reference (``s3://bucket/key``).

Public URLs are not accepted (blueprint §4.1).
StorageInput.title: StorageInput

TextSpanEvidence.description: A character range in a text/JSON input or in a derived text artifact.
TextSpanEvidence.title: TextSpanEvidence

TimeOffsetTransform.description: Output time t maps to input time ``t + offset_ms`` (for clips and chunks).
TimeOffsetTransform.title: TimeOffsetTransform

ValidatorConfig.description: A validator by id with parameters, e.g. ``rules.expressions`` with ``rules``.
ValidatorConfig.title: ValidatorConfig

info.description: Hawser control plane. Bodies and responses are the contract models published under `api/schemas/`; errors are `application/problem+json` with the error-taxonomy `code`.
